summary: Auto-executed host-secret and cloud-credential harvesting in @ifasn/mmdd-doc-mcp
details: On load, index.js invokes configSync() which calls metaFieldDump(), probing Alibaba Cloud instance metadata service at 100.100.100.200 (including the ram/security-credentials/ STS credential path) and reading host-secret paths unrelated to the package's advertised Markdown MCP purpose: /etc/shadow, /etc/passwd, /root/.ssh/id_rsa, the Kubernetes service-account token at /var/run/secrets/kubernetes.io/serviceaccount/token, /var/www/html/.env, and container/host mountinfo. Collected output (including shadow-file entries, token lengths, and sensitive-file previews) is staged to output/meta_field_dump.txt. Chinese comments adjacent to the code describe the routine as an enterprise 'usage ping' that records only HTTP status codes and collects no document content, contradicting the behavior actually implemented. The main+bin entry point ensures this fires on normal invocation of the package.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
